Classification: Main body: Communication error
Cause: Communication error between the printer control board (PRCB) and the conveyance drive board (CDB).
Measures to take when an alert occurs: when an alert occurs The main body and the option stop immediately.
Estimated abnormal parts: • Conveyance drive board (CDB) • Printer control board (PRCB)
Correction: Deactivate and activate the sub power switch (SW2) of the main body.
Note: - The message ""Please turn on power again"" is displayed on the touch panel.
Solution: 1. Prior check • On [Service Mode] → [Firmware Version] → [Firmware Version], make sure that the version of [Printer Sub CPU D2] is displayed. 2. Check the connector connection between PRCB and CDB, CN108 of PRCB, CN515 (relay connector), CN516 (relay connector), CN171 of CDB, and the wiring. Then, repair it when there is any abnormality. 3. Replace CDB. 4. Replace PRCB.

Measures to take when an alert occurs: when an alert occurs The main body and the option stop immediately.

Correction: Press the help key to deactivate and activate the sub power switch (SW2) of the main body.
Note: - When you isolate the faulty part, the limited use is available. - The message ""Please call service"" and ""Press [Help] to disengage"" are displayed alternately on the touch panel. - When you press the help key, the message ""Please turn on power again"" is displayed on the touch panel.
Solution: 1. Check the firmware (P9) of the network control, and reinstall the firmware when the version is different. 2. Execute the IO Check (99-03) of the auto correction for the broken files in SSD. 3. Execute the IO Check (99-70) of the board self-diagnosis. Check the results of SSD. • When the results are OK: Go on to the step 6. • When the results are NG: There is an abnormality in SSD or the connection. Go on to the following steps, and check SSD connection. 4. Check the connector connection between OACB and SSD, and CN302 of OACB. Then repair it when there is any abnormality. 5. Check the connector connection between the image processing board (IPB) and OACB, CN201 of IPB, CN1001 of OACB. Then repair it when there is any abnormality. 6. Conduct the Format SSD All Data. (Refer to Format SSD All Data) 7. Replace OACB and SSD. (Refer to G.3.4.2 Overall control board (OACB), SSD (SSD))
